summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to reduce the securities covered under its March 2026 prospectus supplement, now covering only 81,500 ordinary shares already sold and issued to a single institutional investor. The filing reflects adjustments for 1-for-60 and 1-for-15 reverse stock splits effected in 2026. The shares are listed on Nasdaq under VCIG; last reported price on August 21, 2026 was $0.2129 per share. This is a routine follow-on offering document, not a special-situation event, with no control, premium, or strategic implications.
